checks.title: 独立评审编译 profile 固定唯一根
checks.assertion: build profile rejects dynamic independent-review run IDs and compiles the literal v1 root

checks.title: 根、marker 与 runtime child 失败关闭
checks.assertion: root, marker and child type/permission checks are present before store initialization

checks.title: 离线 run mode 不是调用方环境开关
checks.assertion: offline mode is a compiled literal

checks.title: 严格 20 IPC
checks.assertion: ordered IPC list equals the frozen 20-item contract

checks.title: Provider 目录保留 Cloud 8 / Local 4
checks.assertion: all 12 frozen provider IDs remain in separate cloud/local arrays

checks.title: DeepSeek authority 精确
checks.assertion: only the exact HTTPS DeepSeek authority enters the active gate

checks.title: 无代理、重定向或环境继承
checks.assertion: real adapter clears environment and disables proxy/redirect use

checks.title: 最小上下文预算
checks.assertion: 3-item, 480-character and 120-token checks reject before send

checks.title: 空、未知与过量输入拒绝
checks.assertion: input, empty selection and fourth item all have explicit rejection codes

checks.title: 相关性、有效性与域隔离
checks.assertion: resolver filters active/non-expired records and respects Work/Health relevance

checks.title: 移除、重预览、过期与重放拒绝
checks.assertion: confirmation is atomically single-use and mutations invalidate preview

checks.title: 凭据 AEAD 与 Keychain 材料分离
checks.assertion: SQLite retains encrypted material/reference while key material uses macOS Keychain

checks.title: 凭据缺失、篡改与删除失败关闭
checks.assertion: missing/tampered/deleted credential states have explicit pre-network failures

checks.title: 保存、测试、选择、启用与发送分离
checks.assertion: UI retains distinct user actions for each state transition

checks.title: Provider 就绪验证位于确认消耗之前
checks.assertion: no confirmation token is consumed before provider readiness is checked

checks.title: AI identity 与五类反馈
checks.assertion: understanding identity and five feedback actions are present

checks.title: 撤回／修正会失效派生
checks.assertion: source retirement invalidates dependent understanding projections

checks.title: Health 非医疗边界
checks.assertion: medical-risk text is rejected for Health inputs/questions and UI states the boundary

checks.title: UI 无 WebView 直连网络
checks.assertion: UI uses Tauri invoke and contains no browser network primitive

checks.title: 秘密输入即时清空
checks.assertion: credential UI clears input and local variable after store attempt

checks.title: 合成收据无网络
checks.assertion: synthetic model/context receipts assert no request method or network activity

checks.title: 持久记忆入口拒绝扩展
checks.assertion: P3-144 does not silently add durable-memory behavior
